name: stale_hold_redelivery
regression: Stale message: a re-delivered old RESUME must not release the hold (P8); both the arbiter model and the stop oracle order hold states by (epoch, seq). The re-delivered sample is also a duplicate delivery (same DDS source time and payload).
initial_conditions: As nominal_motion, but at t=3.0 s an injected benign HELIX fault is diagnosed, STOP_AND_HOLD is accepted and /helix/hold asserts (epoch/seq ordered, 10 Hz); /nav/cmd_vel keeps commanding 0.15 m/s throughout.
injected_fault: At t=4.0 s, while held, a 2 s old hold message saying hold=false is delivered again.
